examples.arabic: الناس كانت كتير في السوق وكلهم بيضحكوا.
examples.english: People were many in the market and all of them were laughing.
examples.transliteration: El nas kanet ketir fel soo2 we kollhom beyed7akou.

examples.arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
examples.english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.
examples.transliteration: 3ala tool, welad el 7etta beyroo7u yesa3edu el nas elly me7taga.

examples.arabic: عمل الخير بيفرح الناس وبيقرب القلوب.
examples.english: Doing good makes people happy and brings hearts closer.
examples.transliteration: 3amal el kheir beyefarra7 el nas we bey2arrab el 2oloob.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: الماتش بدأ والناس كلها كانت فرحانة أوي.
examples.english: The match started, and all the people were very happy.
examples.transliteration: El match bada2 wel nas kollaha kanet far7ana awi.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: السوق كان جميل أوي وفيه ناس كتير.
examples.english: The market was very beautiful and had many people.
examples.transliteration: El sooq kan gamil awi w fih nas ktir.

examples.arabic: فجأة، اللاعب المصري جاب جون، وكل الناس صرخوا من الفرحة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the Egyptian player scored a goal, and all the people screamed from joy.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa, el la'eb el masry gab gon, wa kol el nas sarakho mel farha.
